notes.title: Energy Hunter Boy gameplay trailer 2020
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
a new gameplay trailer is ready, showing all the main features and dynamics of the game:

- fighting
- killing enemies
- collection of energy bonuses
- terrain modeling (destruction / creation)
- deactivation of the generators through the aura of energy
- return to the extraction point to win!

Enjoy!

[previewyoutube=vHlu_ECqjLw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Gameplay update 1.3 now live!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178992/f9273f92539807e3894b8b47ee9366d527bca917.jpg
Hello to all,
we arrived at the gameplay update 1.3, with great improvements for the playability and variety of maps.

Automatic deactivation!
Now the deactivation of the generators is almost automatic, with the energy aura enlarging independently next to the selected generator.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178992/bd93a9b99b8216fabbaf6960b45a808f1557783f.jpg
Improved health objects!
Visualization and management of health objects has been improved, which now also offer many more points.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178992/434e01200c4df25223cc551b2c9e697116b65269.jpg
Greater variety of procedural maps!
The procedural generation of maps has been improved, with the addition of semi-flat and completely flat maps.
This was also done to lighten and facilitate gameplay.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178992/c228e08d0ad6f0002664306715e5f2326dc92733.jpg

notes.title: Gameplay Update 1.2 now live!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178992/1e1b7e0be34fb7bdb8179b6ea70a859c028b4779.jpg
Hello everyone,
we have released another gameplay update, version 1.2!
New platform management
Now the position of the platforms with the generators has been improved, and the annoying large holes that were under the structures have been eliminated.
By this way it is much easier to achieve the mission objectives!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178992/b4f34b1dd14dda9239a5e64884454f46827c35b7.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178992/4651ccc9f5eae5dcbaa10f4147869665b8950b47.jpg
New management of the VIGOR
The collection of these fundamental Vigor objects will now simply increase the speed of our hero, but will not decrease performance during the mission.
If the autonomy of the robot is at zero, then the speed will return to normal.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178992/fb24db8f9da87101c312fc38ed18b16a2ad34e20.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178992/754e78b9264596bc9408a05877b168232f51ecff.jpg

notes.title: Gameplay Update 1.1 now LIVE!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178992/092f10abbc1133a7bd60c7095f14e4b461bee13c.jpg
Hello everyone,
we have simplified the gameplay and greatly improved the interface of the game during the missions.
Now the game-loop is much clearer and more fluid.

The aim of the game is to deactivate all the generators to pass the levels.
Kill enemies --> Take ENERGY bonuses --> Deactivate the selected generator through the energy aura --> Deactivate all generators in the level --> Return to the extraction point to win!
You can also modify the terrain to reach the targets of the missions!
Controls:
Mouse/arrows --> Move
Fire1 key --> Shoot
Hold Jump key --> Enter in trace mode/jump
Esc key --> Pause game
F1 key --> Tutorial
Tab key --> Select weapon
Q,E keys --> Destroy/Add terrain at selected position

To enter in 'deactivation mode' and to deform the terrain, you need energy.
This energy can be earned by collecting the many bonuses that appear every time you kill an enemy!
The energy decreases every second.
Take the VIGOR objects to increase the AMMO and AUTONOMY.
Take the 'health items' when you turn off a power generator.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178992/7d4101b119285cc32c9013df3022a10c5ba33538.jpg

notes.title: Energy Hunter Boy, model and fight!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35178992/9d9f5192a3df408533984d6c6d24edbd0eda38a3.jpg

Hello everyone,
we want to describe the core mechanics of the game, especially the real-time modeling of the terrain.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35178992/3ccb17fe7fd5477a79ad04ed450ab0a556122538.jpg

Our little robot has to collect ENERGY, and this energy is also used to build and destroy the land, in order to open new ways and new game dynamics.

The following gameplay trailer shows all this.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3h_s3T0bObg
By digging the ground and by destroying the vegetation it is also possible to collect the 'Vigor', necessary for the ammunition and the running speed of the protagonist.
Without ENERGY it is not possible to modify the terrain!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35178992/b0a04a72da73e923347c90ade640356bc978383a.jpg

Controls
Mouse / arrows -> Move
Fire1 key -> Shoot
Hold Jump Key -> Enter in trace mode / jump
Esc key -> Pause game
F1 key -> Tutorial
Tab key -> Select weapon
Q, E keys -> Destroy / Add terrain at selected position (you need ENERGY!)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35178992/140a6812bae8c3613f43ffc0b8418d9366014238.jpg

Vigor
The VIGOR is the element that strengthens the small robot, and serves to increase autonomy and ammunition.
VIGOR objects can be collected on the ground or extracted from vegetation by digging.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35178992/3cf81fce7f3658dd2579a77ba9e66bbb6c67d5a1.jpg

By this way the dynamic of a shooter game are combined with the object collection and terrain modeling!

Game loop
The object is to collect and extract the number of health objects.
To do this you must go in 'deactivation mode' to deactivate the selected power generator, then the 'health' items will be created. You have to collect and bring home these items.
To enter in 'deactivation mode' and to create / destroy terrain, you need energy.
This energy can be earned by collecting the many bonuses that appear every time you kill an enemy (there are many types of bonuses)!
The energy decreases every second.
Take the VIGOR objects to increase the AMMO and AUTONOMY.
Take the 'health items' when you turn off a power generator, and then take them home (extraction point!).

Enjoy!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35178992/6293d743a2507c0099ddec1f94c63f09731c46fd.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35178992/418b309001e4de1fca6a44c7c8e469034ddb4f6c.jpg

notes.title: Energy Hunter Boy released on Steam!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35178992/7d4101b119285cc32c9013df3022a10c5ba33538.jpg

Hello everyone,
it has been a long journey full of unexpected events, but finally Energy Hunter Boy has been released and it's LIVE on Steam!

Energy Hunter Boy is an evolved shooter game with fantastic procedural scenarios based on Voxels and real-time terrain modeling.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35178992/ea137dabe3c2f6701843e1704f9bf6699ef123c3.jpg

You will have fun exploring, modifying, building or destroying the terrain of the wonderful worlds of the game, and you will fight to destroy the hordes of enemies and to deactivate the extremely dangerous crazy machines.

You can also collect resources from the vegetation by digging, using the soil modification tool.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35178992/b81b255a25cadcddd7a1a2d6dc4266d971c1948c.jpg

You will also enjoy progressing with the skills of our hero, and you can challenge all your friends through our achievements and our multiple online leaderboards!

There are indeed the following online rankings, to compete with players from around the world:

 Highscores
 Generators deactivated
 Enemies killed
 Bonuses collected

There are also 40 Steam achievements!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35178992/2d9f23cc46e737ca10c9ba5660e4dff6fb0bebd0.jpg

You will like to follow the full story of the little robot through the three main campaigns of the game, and you will be able to unlock a fourth secret and endless campaign for endless fun!

We are excited to start this new adventure and we hope so much that you enjoy the game!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35178992/7440c4be3999fede16ee6eff11551924098e02ce.jpg
